LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking Active Listening Pronunciation and articulation, tones an
Topic 1.1: Active Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active Listening, part of Listening and Speaking Active Listening Pronunciation and articulation, tones an in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can you use to improve your pronunciation? 2 叫......,来自肯尼亚的中部,他住 在......,他今年......岁,他会说斯瓦 希里语,您呢?/您贵姓?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording on Chinese formal greetings(e.g. 您好、早上 好、下午好、晚上好、老师好、幸 会)and repeat after it,

2. watch a simple video conversation on informal Chinese greetings in polite contexts and practise saying them aloud in turns,

3. listen to an audio recording about introduction of self and others by their name, age, origin, residence, languages spoken and answer the questions,

4. role-play introducing themselves and their friends by their name, age, origin, residence and languages spoken in turns (e.g. 您好/早上好/下午好/晚上 好/老师好,我叫......,来自肯尼亚的 西部, 我住在......,我今年......岁, 我会说英语。他是我的朋友,他

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording on Chinese formal greetings(e.g. 您好、早上 好、下午好、晚上好、老师好、幸 会)and repeat after it,
2. watch a simple video conversation on informal Chinese greetings in polite contexts and practise saying them aloud in turns,
3. listen to an audio recording about introduction of self and others by their name, age, origin, residence, languages spoken and answer the questions,
4. role-play introducing themselves and their friends by their name, age, origin, residence and languages spoken in turns (e.g. 您好/早上好/下午好/晚上 好/老师好,我叫......,来自肯尼亚的 西部, 我住在......,我今年......岁, 我会说英语。他是我的朋友,他

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Active Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: the learner speaks clearly and effectively as they practise introducing themselves and others

fluently and clearly.

Values:
Patriotism: This is reinforced as the learner respects fellow citizens by using formal, polite language to greet others, and

introduce themselves in class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner works harmoniously with peers to take turns in the conversation on greetings and

introductions with peers.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of using polite phrases and expressions in introducing oneself and others to English and

Kiswahili.
